page.summary:
The page part of round 2 is finished and committed on toggles-fixes in scratch pt. 47c5a68277 (N1, before the restart) is followed by 76af3ee50c (the page) and b152652e7f (the checks). The working tree is clean. Every finding was reproduced on live (8914), on HEAD's page or on a scratch page with the fix taken out, then shown fixed on the tree, each with a check that goes red before and green after.

N1: the concordance shows at least «1 location · here» for the line's own reading. The critic's Ruth scenario was run again with N2 in place.

N2: a unit (one entry, or one reading across words, with the same pick at each word) now prints once where its words stand in one run (one part over them, data-wn, one blob). Where its words stand apart (39 units, all BDB's), each word keeps its line as it rests and the card says why, because no line can stand over both words. Count over the data's 215 units: live 212 twice and 3 span lines; tree 175 once, 39 held, 1 span line, 0 twice. UBS's «Aram Zoba» is left, and the notes say what the corpus lane would have to give (each UBS meaning's word span).

N3: a press paints the sections in view at once and the rest in slices of about 200 ms, nearest first, and at once on scroll or read. Psalms built whole: the longest task fell from 10.0 s (press) and 11.8 s (back on STEP) to 0.48 s and 0.58 s. Lines read after scrolling Ruth and Psalms under each source and back on STEP all equal the first paint.

N4: when the book file lands, the card is not rebuilt while the pointer or the focus is on it. 0 of 8 pills move at 1100x900 and 412x915; on live all 8 move about 205 px.

N7: under a kept source the book file is asked as soon as the index names it (24 ms on the tree against 293 ms on live). The cost is one extra index request, because the boot's index fetch line is one the kinds team changes.

N8 and N9: titles and labels are fixed (one name, STEP).

Question 3 is now stated in the page's comment.

P3 on Ruth: the page was wrong, and it is fixed. A word inside a run read its pieces off its own hidden line.

Lint: the page is at baseline and the tools have no new warnings. Merge with kinds-build: zone.html has 2 conflicts, and both are identical, block for block, to HEAD's own 2 conflicts. This part adds none, and the tools have 0.

outcomes.finding: N2: a unit a source files at each of two words printed under both words (Amos 3:14:10-11 BDB «Bethel · sense 1»; Daniel 1:8:8-9 MACULA «with food»)
outcomes.proof: One unit means the words of one entry across words (the lattice's headword is the same at each word and its letters run across the boundary) or of one reading the place gives across words (TAHOT's hyphen), where the source's line at every word comes from the same pick in its book file. For BDB that is the record and sense; for UBS the meaning and its pieces; for MACULA the words as given. Units are never matched by text likeness. Where the words stand in one run, the unit prints once: one part over its words (data-wn) and one blob (spanPairs). Amos 3:14:10-11 now shows one part «Bethel · sense 1» with wn=2, and Daniel 1:8:8-9 one part «with food» with wn=2 (p2/out/n2-tree.json). Where the words stand apart, a line cannot stand over both, so each word keeps its line as it rests. Genesis 23:2:3-4 shows «at + Kiriath» «Arba», and the card says «reading · STEP at this place · BDB reads these 2 words as one, and they stand apart». This is the same hold call 5 gives a run the source does not read whole. Count over the data's 215 units (BDB 202, UBS 8, MACULA 5), each under its own source (p2/out/units-by-source-and-book.txt). Live: 212 twice and 3 a run's span line. Tree: 175 once, 39 held (all BDB: Kiriath Arba, Abed Nego, Bethel at Jeremiah 48:13, the Pi of Pi-hahiroth standing in another run's cell, and others), 1 a run's span line (I Kings 13:1 «El-bethel»), 0 twice. outcomes.finding: N2 remainder: a UBS line filed at one word that reads its neighbors' words with no mark across them (II Samuel 10:6:15 «Aram Zoba»)
outcomes.proof: The book file gives each place UBS's meaning and its pieces, but never the words of the verse that meaning covers. At 10:6:15 (the object marker) UBS has «Aram Zoba», and Aram (16) and Zobah (17) carry no UBS meaning at all. TAHOT marks nothing across these words, and each word has its own headword. The page therefore cannot tell this case without reading the English, and does not guess. What the corpus lane would have to give: for each UBS meaning it files at a place, the verse words it covers (place numbers or the source's word ids), or at least a mark that the meaning is filed at a word that is not its head. This text is in the notes for the lane's letter, and in the page's comment above dfltEntriesOf.

not_done: Units whose words stand apart are held, not printed once. These are 39 BDB units, 78 words. A page line cannot stand over two words that stand apart: printed under each word it is the doubled word, and printed under one word it reads as that word's alone. If the owner wants such a unit printed, the page would have to lay its words as one cell under the source, which means re-laying sections when the source is pressed.

N3 costs more in total time: Psalms built whole takes about 28-35 s of sliced repaint, against 10-12 s for each of the old single tasks (the press and the file's landing). The page stays responsive and in-view lines change at once. Tools that press on a big book built whole should allow about 30 s before the page says it is ready (check-default-picks' 30 s on II Samuel passed).

N7: under a kept source the index is requested twice (41 KB), because the boot's index fetch line and the line under it are lines the kinds branch changes. A stalled book file still holds the page blank under a kept source, as PLAN-MERGED line 74 intends; only the start of the request moved.
check-same-product-v1's one-line change (a part over several words) was only parsed, linted and merged. The gate's S1 reads chapter pages built from main's engine until the round rebuilds it.
check-ruled-equals-first-paint-v1 on Ruth under UBS is red at E1 and E4 (1:1#0, 1:1#4, 1:4#1). HEAD's page fails the same way, so it is not from this part and was not investigated further.

Edge: 1 Chronicles 2:54 has two words that sit in both a headword unit and a different halves group. The page takes the headword group; check-default-picks' model iterates both. D7's works do not include this case.
The verse export still cites each word of a unit inside a run with the unit's text, as BDB files it at each word. The line prints it once.
The default picks note's BDB share still counts the 78 held words as BDB's. That count is the bake's to change.
D20 of check-default-picks-v1 stays red until the round bakes the receipt again (the tools builder's finding).
lead_must_run: After merging kinds-build into toggles-fixes, resolve zone.html's 2 conflicts. Both were already there between round 1's tip and kinds-build: the reset pill's title in the row of pills, and remember()'s DFLT_OWN beside kindPick. Then run check-rulings-under-sources-v1, check-landing-holds-the-card-v1, check-row-and-card-name-sources-v1, check-default-picks-v1 and check-press-paints-before-seen-v1 (WORKS=ruth,psalms, about 21 min) on the merged tree.

The round with --default-picks (receipt bake), so D20 can go green, and the engine rebuild, so chapter pages carry these page changes. Then check-same-product-v1 S1 under a source exercises the data-wn reading.
Decide whether check-ruled-equals-first-paint-v1's Ruth failure under UBS (pre-existing on HEAD) gets its own fix round.
Put the UBS span request into the corpus lane's letter. The text is in the round-2 page notes, in the section 'For the corpus lane's letter'.

- reopenForDefaults: `if (!landed) reopenCard(); else if (!drawn) reopenCardFree();`. At rest (STEP lit, or none lit), the landing never rebuilds the open card. The hand now also counts a finger's last press on the card or on the word that opened it (dfltFinger, set by a capture pointerdown listener; a mouse press clears it).
